d:
I look back at this and I think "I am so fortunate that I had absent and negligent parents, and that the guy at Lion and Unicorn Comics and Collectibles thought all manga was 'for kids' even when the labeling really should have informed him otherwise."

Maybe he knew, he /did/ rip me off on Magic the Gathering cards a lot.
n: [Manga] Chirality: The Promise Land Complete English compilation
